verdicts.reason: A shrinks the can to a small, unfocused object stranded mid-canvas with a big empty bottom half. The headline runs across the edge of the orange circle, and the logo floats inside the circle, cut off from the text column, so the product loses all its presence. B gives the can real prominence and places the headline/subhead block at the bottom left with the logo as a sign-off at the bottom right. It still has flaws: the centred can does not line up with the left-aligned text, there is a dead gap between the can and the headline, the headline breaks with an orphaned 'summer', and the logo sits on the busy purple circle.
